SCULPTED DRAMA

Embroidere
d Vest
An ivory button-front vest
embroidered with red, pink
and blue flowers, a tiered white
ruffle mini skirt, a gold heart
pendant necklace and a black tote
with tall handles. Long wavy dark
hair, rosy blush and a pale plaster
wall.
